## Primary Services
- TV Mounting & Media Setup: Samsung Frame TV mounting, fireplace wall mounting, full-motion articulating brackets, drop-down ceiling TV mounts, cord concealment.
- Furniture & Custom Closet Assembly: IKEA PAX & modular walk-in wardrobe installation, mirrored closet doors, bed frames, executive office desks, Wayfair & Amazon assembly, outdoor sheds & patio furniture.
- Carpentry & Accent Walls: Acoustic wood slat walls, custom shelving, kitchen pass-through framing, interior & exterior door installation and hinge/lock repair, trim work.
- Drywall, Skim Coating & Interior Painting: Wallpaper glue removal, plaster & greenboard moisture-resistant drywall patching, taping, mudding, smooth skim coating, clean interior painting.
- Home Upgrades, Smart Devices & Repairs: Ring floodlight exterior cameras, Midea U-shaped window AC installation, gallery wall & fine art hanging, gym mirror walls, bathtub/shower silicone caulking, light fixtures, outlets, and flooring/tile repairs.
